subject: general
question: When was the Indian National Science Academy (NSA) established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**January 1935**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian National Science Academy **was **established in January 1935**.
 
• Its **object **of **promoting science **in **India **and **harnessing scientific knowledge **for the **cause of humanity **and **national welfare**.
 
• The **foundation of the Academy**, earlier known as the **National Institute of Sciences of India **(NISI),.
 
• It was the **outcome of joint endeavors **of **several organizations **and **individuals **and the **Indian Science Congress Association **(ISCA) played a leading role in this regard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian National Science Academy **is **a national academy.**
 
• It is **situated **in **New Delhi **for **Indian scientists **in **all branches of science and technology**.
 
• In **August 2019**, Dr. Chandrima Shaha was **appointed **as the **president of the Indian National Science Academy.**
 
• She is the **first woman **to **head the INSA**.
